title: Wire agent-quality suite into CI tiering, BENCHMARKS.md Suite 4, and the scorecard
summary: Add AGQ-2/3/4 to EPIC-17's nightly Tier 2 job (never a PR gate), write a new 'Suite 4: Agent quality (Microsoft Foundry-shaped)' section into BENCHMARKS.md following BM-26's structure, and hand normalized results to EPIC-20's UNI-3 scorecard.
description:
Integration story closing out EPIC-21. Add AGQ-2 (task-completion Pass¹/Pass⁵), AGQ-3 (groundedness), and AGQ-4 (coherence/fluency) to EPIC-17's nightly Tier 2 workflow (BM-21) alongside the existing full matrix, Locust ramps, and IR metrics — these are LLM-judged and non-deterministic exactly like BM-18 and TRU-3, so the same rule applies: they inform and are stamped with judge/model/seed, but never block a PR (BENCH-1's own methodology finding, already enforced by EPIC-17's tiering design, applies identically here).

Write 'Suite 4: Agent quality (Microsoft Foundry-shaped)' into BENCHMARKS.md, structured the same way Suite 1 (retrieval quality) is documented today: methodology summary, per-category results table, and an 'Analysis — what the delta tells us' section matching Run B's existing format. Explicitly cross-reference Suite 1 in this new section so a reader understands Suite 1 answers 'was the right fact retrieved' and Suite 4 answers 'was the generated response task-complete, grounded, and coherent given whatever was retrieved' — two different questions that can and should diverge (a system can score well on one and poorly on the other, and that divergence is itself a finding worth surfacing, not an inconsistency to reconcile away).

Hand off AGQ-2/3/4's normalized results (Pass¹/Pass⁵ percentages, 1-5 groundedness/coherence means) to EPIC-20's UNI-3 scorecard generator as the Agent-Quality sub-score input, in whatever JSON shape UNI-2's scoring spec requires.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- Nightly Tier 2 workflow runs AGQ-2/3/4 and fails loudly (workflow-visible, not silent) only on infrastructure errors, never on a judge-score threshold — matching BM-18/TRU-3's existing non-gating behavior.
- BENCHMARKS.md Suite 4 section exists with a first real run's numbers, not placeholders.
- Scorecard-consumable JSON output shape matches what UNI-3 expects (coordinate directly with UNI-2's finalized spec before finishing).

**Definition of Done:**
- CI workflow change reviewed and passing; BENCHMARKS.md updated; DECISIONS.md gets a short dated entry noting Suite 4's first real numbers, following BRUN-1..4's precedent of recording first-execution results distinctly from the design decision that preceded them.
- Depends on AGQ-2, AGQ-3, AGQ-4 (all three), and EPIC-17's BM-21 (the nightly Tier 2 job this extends).
